adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. The helper is defined as `refreshOAuthTokens(refreshFunction, appSlug, userId: number | null)` and, when sync is enabled, sends `calcomUserId: userId.toString()` to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`. Every other adapter in this diff passes `credential.userId` for that parameter, so using a `credentialId`-named value here would cause the sync endpoint to receive the wrong identifier and potentially sync credentials for the wrong entity.
